page.layout: One page of text: running head and page number at the top; a month heading "JUNIUS."; below it one calendar table with six columns (Aureus numbers, Dies mensis, Litera, festival names, Dies collecti in anno communi, bissextili); the catchword "JULIUS." at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: JUNIUS.
main_text.l: Aurei num. | Dies mensis | Litera | | Dies collecti in anno communi | bissextili

page.notes: The aureus numbers and day numbers sit in separate columns; the table is reconstructed row by row, so the placement of the left-hand numbers beside each day is inferred from the layout. Some numerals in the year columns are uncertain in the scan (e.g. 162, 164, 171). Doubtful digits in the left column were not individually marked.
